title: US August Payrolls Jump 162,000, Triple the 53,000 Forecast; Fed September Hike Odds Rise to 62%
summary: Nonfarm payrolls rose 162,000 in August, well above the 53,000 consensus, while unemployment held at 4.1%. Rate futures now price ~62% probability of a Fed rate hike at the Sept. 15-16 FOMC meeting, up from ~55% before the report. Average hourly earnings rose 0.3% m/m.
why: 非农大幅超预期是本周最重大宏观事件，将9月16日FOMC加息概率从55%推至62%；隐含波动率上升，所有卖出期权（sell put/covered call）策略须关注短期方向风险；下周CPI数据将提供进一步确认。

title: Nvidia Agrees to Buy Hugging Face for $12.93B, Completing AI Vertical Integration from Silicon to Model Marketplace
summary: Nvidia entered a definitive agreement to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93B ($11.9B cash + up to $1B staff equity retention). Hugging Face hosts 18M+ developers, 3M+ models, and 1M+ applications. Deal expected to close H1 2027 pending regulatory approval. Platform will remain multi-cloud and multi-accelerator.
why: 延续报道：英伟达此举从芯片延伸至AI开发者平台，完成从硅到模型市场全栈垂直整合；分析师称战略意义重大，NVDA盘中涨约2%；交割需等监管批准，持有NVDA的期权需关注整合进展与反垄断风险对隐含波动率的影响。

title: Tesla Cybercab Goes Public in Austin, NHTSA Opens Safety Probe; Shares Tumble on Underwhelming Launch
summary: Tesla opened Cybercab robotaxi rides to the public in Austin on Sept. 4 (45 vehicles authorized, no steering wheel or pedals). NHTSA launched a formal investigation into how Tesla self-certified the vehicle as federally compliant. Tesla stock fell sharply; federal rules cap no-steering-wheel vehicle sales at 2,500/year.
why: 延续报道：Robotaxi首次商业化里程碑，但NHTSA调查形成监管不确定性，股价已大跌；联邦年售2500辆上限若不获豁免将严重制约规模扩张；对TSLA期权持仓，波动率上升且方向不明，需关注调查结论与监管进展。

title: Middle East Tensions Push Oil Above $93; Asian Stocks Fall, S&P 500 Futures Drop Ahead of Sept. 8 Open
summary: Escalating Middle East tensions pushed Brent crude above $93/barrel, amplifying inflation concerns. Asian equities fell and S&P 500 futures declined heading into the Sept. 8 session, as markets absorbed the stronger jobs data and rising Fed hike probability.
why: 中东地缘风险叠加非农超预期，油价通胀压力与加息预期形成双重压制；港股三大指数同步走低，所有持仓短期估值承压；高油价与加息预期组合对消费类持仓（餐饮、旅游、零售）影响尤为显著。

title: Bitcoin Holds $79,000 as Fed Hike Odds Climb; September Historically Crypto's Worst Month
summary: BTC traded near $79,000 as of Sept. 7, pressured by rising Fed rate hike expectations after the payrolls beat. September has historically been bitcoin's worst-performing month since 2013. Broader crypto market slipped with hike odds climbing to 62%.
why: 加密市场随加息预期升温整体承压；Circle（CRCL）USDC储备金收益与利率正相关，高利率环境短期利好CRCL核心收入，但若市场情绪恶化将压制整体估值；CLARITY Act参议院投票预计9月15日，是CRCL近期重要催化剂。

title: 腾讯控股(00700)9月7日斥资约1亿港元回购22.8万股，年内累计回购逾4300万股
summary: 腾讯控股于2026年9月7日在联交所回购22.8万股，回购价格区间港元438.4至442.4，合计耗资约1亿港元。截至本次公告，年内已累计回购43,240,700股，授权总额为911,799,163股（2026年5月13日股东会通过）。
why: 腾讯持续高频、高金额回购（近期每日约1亿港元），年内累计已超4300万股，对股价形成有力支撑，有助于EPS稳定增长；稳定的回购节奏降低持仓波动预期，有利于维持sell put策略的安全垫。
source: 联交所披露 (HKEXnews) / 智通财经

title: Circle Confirms Arc Blockchain Sept. 16 Mainnet Launch With BlackRock, DTCC, Visa, Mastercard as Founding Validators
summary: Circle announced the founding validator cohort for Arc ahead of its Sept. 16 public mainnet launch: BlackRock, DTCC, Galaxy, Global Payments, ICE, Mastercard, MoneyGram, SBI Group, Standard Chartered, Sumitomo, and Visa. Arc uses USDC as native gas token, targets tokenized assets and institutional cross-border payments.
why: 延续报道：Circle Arc主网是CRCL自上市以来最重要的产品催化剂，代表稳定币基础设施向Layer-1区块链扩展；BlackRock/DTCC/Visa/Mastercard机构背书阵容强大，CRCL自8月5日财报已涨约61%；9月15日CLARITY Act投票+9月16日主网双催化，期权隐含波动率可能在此期间上升。
